audit_items.proof_trace: The primary kiosk path calls the SECURITY DEFINER RPC `record_attendance_by_card(p_card_id text)`, which generates its own timestamp via `v_now timestamptz := now()` — no timestamp parameter is accepted from the caller. Direct table INSERT by anon or authenticated users is blocked by `REVOKE ALL ON attendance.attendances FROM anon` and the absence of an INSERT RLS policy for authenticated users (FORCE RLS active). The admin `forceToggleAttendance` server action also derives its timestamp from `new Date()` on the Node.js server, with no client-supplied parameter.
